assessments.reasoning: Archive member HyperSpec/Front/Help.htm is byte-identical to the directly acquired publisher Help page. Its Abstract and Authorship Information support the attributed descriptive assertion.

challenge.method: I compared the exact archive Help member to the online copy, then checked the publisher’s 7.0 release announcement and the Help section’s claims about ANSI, derivation, and editor discrepancies.
challenge.results: The publisher confirms the 7.0 artifact. Its Help text situates Common Lisp within the Lisp family, identifies the markup as based on ANSI under permission, and names the ANSI print edition as definitive. Separate issue material does not acquire authority from being bundled.

limitations: The evidence is the publisher’s derived HyperSpec 7.0. This review does not compare the complete ANSI text or establish ANSI conformity of any vendor or host.
